title: Thapa2025: Freewill reach-and-grasp motor-execution dataset from Thapa et al. 2025
description: A scalp EEG dataset of self-paced (freewill) reach-and-grasp motor execution from 23 healthy participants across 49 sessions, comprising 6808 trials. On each trial the participant freely chose one of four cups (two water-filled, two empty) and the timing of the movement, defining four target classes. Recorded with a 31-channel Brain Products actiCHamp system plus EOG and auxiliary channels, the data support brain-machine interface research on natural movement intention and target decoding.
methods_description: EEG was recorded at 250 Hz with a Brain Products actiCHamp Plus amplifier and actiCAP snap active gel electrodes (31 EEG channels, 4 EOG, accelerometer and audio cue channels), referenced to Cz. Participants performed self-paced reach-and-grasp movements toward one of four cups, with audio start/end cues, in 1-3 sessions of 5 runs each.
